items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-07-14
items.q: The drummer we had in the band was Eddie Jones... Dr. David Fridge played tenor in the band.

ctx.x: And the bottom dropped out of it, and he lost everything that he had, including our homes and everything. All right. At that very time, my mother died at the age of 39 years old. Broke my father's heart. He got sick and almost died himself. Doctor told him there wasn't one thing in the world that would save him. He wanted to change climates and locations and everything and get away from the whole thing. items.q: No. Fridge died about five years ago in Mobile. He was a dentist.

ctx.x: No. Fridge died about five years ago in Mobile. He was a dentist.
I've heard of him. I just wondered where I'd heard of him. I think Johnny Hyman or whatever you want to call him mentioned him.
